items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-28
items.q: Pastor Sam, Bill told me yesterday. Yeah. I thought it was Bay St. Louis. But now he used to be a heck of a clarinet player.

ctx.x: He used to work here. Great guy, bro. He's livin' in past Christian now. That's his home. Uh, maybe Bay St. Louis, I can't remember.

Pastor Sam, Bill told me yesterday. Yeah. I thought it was Bay St. Louis. But now he used to be a heck of a clarinet player. Uh-huh. Then he changed the saxophone, and he got tough with that saxophone. Couldn't nobody beat him right now.
